title: An AI4AI Framework for Visual Token Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2608.07193v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Visual-token pruning can substantially reduce the inference cost of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet existing methods largely rely on fixed, handcrafted heuristics and costly expert trial and error. As pruning objectives, budgets, and model architectures diversify, manually navigating the expanding design space becomes increasingly difficult. This paper aims to build an AI4AI framework for visual-token pruning by addressing a natural question: Can large language models automatically design effective visual-token reduction algorithms? Although LLMs possess broad algorithmic knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, translating such general knowledge into effective solutions for a specialized task remains nontrivial. We argue that the key lies in designing an appropriate search-state representation that connects the internal knowledge of LLMs with the structural requirements and constraints of visual-token pruning. translated_title: 一种面向视觉令牌剪枝的AI4AI框架
translated_abstract: 视觉令牌剪枝能够大幅降低多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的推理成本，然而现有方法在很大程度上依赖于固定的、手工设计的启发式规则以及代价高昂的专家反复试验。随着剪枝目标、预算和模型架构的日益多样化，人工探索不断扩大的设计空间变得愈发困难。本文旨在构建一个用于视觉令牌剪枝的AI4AI框架，以回答一个自然的问题：大语言模型能否自动设计有效的视觉令牌缩减算法？尽管大语言模型拥有广泛的算法知识和强大的推理能力，但将这些通用知识转化为特定任务的有效解决方案仍然并非易事。我们认为，关键在于设计合适的搜索状态表示，将大语言模型的内部知识与视觉令牌剪枝的结构需求和约束相连接。
tldr: 提出一种AI4AI框架，利用大语言模型自动设计视觉令牌剪枝算法，通过设计合适的搜索状态表示将LLM的通用算法知识转化为多模态大模型推理加速的专用解决方案。
en_tdlr: Proposes an AI4AI framework that leverages large language models to automatically design effective visual-token pruning algorithms for multimodal LLMs, with the key innovation of a search-state representation bridging LLMs' internal knowledge and pruning task constraints.
